sentences: For `i64`, `u64` and `f64`, V_CMP writes the predicate to VCC or the named scalar mask, with inactive lane bits cleared.
V_CMPX ANDs the predicate into EXEC and preserves VCC.
Both predicates ignore the source values, including NaNs.

The 12 instructions in `tests/semantic/fixtures/vopc_constant_64.asm` assemble for gfx1030 and are CPU-checked with active and inactive lanes in `test_vopc_const_ordered.py`. [AMD RDNA 2 ISA, VOPC](https://www.amd.com/content/dam/amd/en/documents/radeon-tech-docs/instruction-set-architectures/rdna2-shader-instruction-set-architecture.pdf)
